Loss 0.1: I added eight statements as a new paragraph at the end of "0 What Pragmatism Means". They are the dispute setup ("The corpus of…", "This human witness…", "The resultant metaphysical problem…"), then "Which party is right… 'going round' the squirrel.", the two senses ("If you mean passing from the north…", "But if on the contrary you mean…"), then "Make the distinction…" and "You are both right and both wrong…". The repairs were as follows. "the dispute" in "The corpus of the dispute" was given a name span, "a ferocious metaphysical dispute", taken from the segment's first sentence.
